messages:
harry: FYI I opened a PR to update the model catalog + model card for adapter-tagged variants and runtime fallback behavior for polaris13b+adapter:zephyrus-v2. Adds a compatibility matrix, Terraform route example, CLI/SDK snippets, and a short perf appendix. https://git.company/redwood/docs/pull/4999 :wave:
neha: thanks — link looks good. what's new compared to the nebula/adapter guidance?

harry: main diffs: 1) explicit note about shared KV / context-window reductions when adapter kernels can't share KV layout with base kernels, 2) a terraform-style route example for infra teams, 3) recommended fallback ordering for latency vs quality, and 4) an eval checklist for QE.

li: can you paste the terraform snippet here so infra folks can eyeball?

harry: sure — added to PR, pasted below for quick review:
```hcl
resource "redwood_route" "summarizer" {
  name               = "summarizer"
  model              = "polaris13b+adapter:zephyrus-v2"
  fallback_policy    = ["polaris13b-int8", "polaris13b"]
  max_total_tokens   = 8192
  quality_monitoring = true
}
```

jamie: nice. did you include perf numbers to justify recommending `polaris13b-int8` as the first fallback?

harry: yup, short appendix with A100 perf run (single-request p95): polaris13b (baseline) p95 = 400ms; polaris13b-int8 p95 = 330ms; polaris13b+adapter p95 = 460ms. note in PR: adapters can add ~10-25% decode overhead depending on merged-kernel path and kv-cache layout.

neha: please add a compatibility callout for Private/on-prem: older agents (< v1.9.0) consider `+adapter` variants incompatible and will immediately skip to the base variant, which can surprise teams expecting an adapter-capable fallback. add upgrade steps for customers.

harry: added compatibility table mapping runtime versions -> adapter behavior and a short migration checklist: upgrade agents, re-pull catalog, re-run `rwctl route apply`.

li: editorial nit: change any absolutes like "will fallback" to "may fallback" and soften expectations around output parity.

harry: done. changed phrasing to: "runtime may fallback to a compatible quantized or base variant; this generally preserves intent but can alter phrasing and tokenization."

neha: also add quick CLI smoke examples for support engineers who don't use the SDK.

harry: added two CLI examples in the PR:
1) force prefer-quant: `rwctl infer --model polaris13b+adapter:zephyrus-v2 --input "Summarize these notes" --max-tokens 128 --prefer-quant-fallback`
2) upload route JSON and trigger dry-run: `rwctl route apply --file route-summarizer.json --dry-run`

jamie: can you add a short paragraph in the model card about recommended default fallback orders? e.g., latency-critical routes: `int8` first, quality-critical routes: base first.

harry: added a short guidance table and example JSON for both cases. Also included an explicit line: "If you need bit-exact outputs, pin to an exact variant and disable automatic fallbacks."

qa-bot: quick smoke run completed against polaris13b-int8 fallback using the 5-prompt adapter-regression-set — mean delta 2.8% on the BLEU-like metric, no truncation issues. CI results: https://ci.company/qa-runs/11042

docs-ci-bot: PR 4999 docs build: success \u2705 — Preview available: https://docs-preview.company/4999

li: one more editorial: use "aims to preserve intent" instead of stronger language.

harry: updated wording in the model card and catalog note. pushed.

neha: looks good to me. I'll ask support to link this PR in the customer advisory for private upgrades. Merge after QA signs off on full cluster run.

jamie: thanks, this should cut down a lot of adapter-related support tickets.

harry: merging after final QE signoff. tagging @qa-team. :shipit:
